subject.title: [Bug]: Markdown frontmatter parser treats non-delimiter --- prefixes as metadata fences

question: Which open closing PR should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: The issue is valid and already has multiple open candidate fixes, so a maintainer should pick one landing path instead of starting another repair lane.

options.title: Review and land the strongest proven candidate
options.body: Use the linked PR with sufficient proof and the broadest aligned parser/stripper coverage as the canonical fix, then close the remaining duplicate PRs after merge.

options.title: Ask for a narrower replacement
options.body: Pause the current PRs if maintainers want a different helper shape or smaller surface before merge.

options.title: Keep all candidates open briefly
options.body: Allow normal PR review to settle the canonical branch, accepting some duplicated review overhead.

recommendation.title: Review and land the strongest proven candidate
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR with sufficient proof and the broadest aligned parser/stripper coverage as the canonical fix, then close the remaining duplicate PRs after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current parser and affected duplicated stripper helpers trace most directly to this person's recent merged history on the relevant files.
